description: «Collegamenti con gli aeroporti» of the planner: a city station and an airport station of the curated catalogue (catalogue ids), served by the trains of at least one of the packs. A route served only by city-line packs (a people mover, a metro) does not say «trains».

packs.note: A regional railway of gtfs-transit/: it serves Bari Aeroporto with real trains.
The Marconi Express people mover: a metro line of the city pack.

routes.note: Roma Termini ↔ Fiumicino Aeroporto (Trenitalia regional express).
Milano Centrale and Milano Cadorna ↔ Malpensa Aeroporto (Terminal 1; Trenord RE51 and RE54).
Bari ↔ Bari Aeroporto (Ferrotramviaria; «Bari» is the catalogue station of its stop at Bari Centrale).
Torino Porta Susa ↔ Caselle Torinese Aeroporto (SFM A).
Bologna Centrale ↔ Bologna Aeroporto (Marconi Express people mover: a metro line of the city pack, its stops about 130 m and 150 m from the two catalogue stations).
